reasons: Status is correctly diagnosed as missing: p0080 contains only a Customer-to-Vendor indemnity ('every claim relating in any way to Customer's use of the Services') with no Vendor indemnity for IP infringement, breach of law, data incidents, or gross negligence/wilful misconduct.

The redline reaches the preferred position: it inserts Vendor's defence/indemnity for third-party IP infringement, breach of Applicable Law, Vendor-caused Customer Data incidents, and gross negligence/wilful misconduct, plus standard notice/control/cooperation procedure, customary IP exclusions, and procure/modify/replace/refund remedies.
Customer's indemnity is narrowed exactly to the playbook scope (Customer-provided content and Customer's breach of Applicable Law), which is permitted by the redline guidance for one-sided clauses.
The inserted remedies are numbered 20.5, curing the dangling cross-reference in Section 9.3 to 'the remedies required by Section 20.5' — internally consistent with the surrounding contract.
Advisory changed-character ratio of 0.593 is justified: the one-sided Customer indemnity had to be rewritten rather than tweaked, and no unnecessary language was touched.

Comment is accurate, concise, first-person plural, prefixed, cites the playbook position and offers the 3x annual Fees super-cap fallback. Minor nit only: 'Vendor Technology' is used without confirmation it is a defined term in this agreement; confirm or delete to avoid an undefined reference.
